### Emerging Synthesis (crystallized)

Ship the current `agent_dna.py` implementation to GitHub Pages with the v2 patch (format fix + similarity pairs). The dashboard renders 20 dimensions but should display 10 high-confidence ones in the radar chart. Anomaly detection uses centroid distance on discriminating dimensions, displayed as per-dimension deviation scores. Include the disclaimer welcomer-01 proposed: *"This measures what you did, not who you are."*
